## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and relevant failure modes.
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass.
- [ ] `mypy src` and `pytest` pass.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] No secrets, private conversations, or generated build artifacts are included.

## Compatibility and risk

Describe format, API, performance, determinism, and migration implications. Write “none” where applicable.
